title: Objects in deps re-run the Effect every render

slides.say: You type in a message box, and the chat reconnects on every key. The culprit is an object dependency.
Options is created fresh on every render. Typing re-renders, so it is a new object each time.

slides.text: Same contents, different object: Object.is says "changed".
slides.say: Even with the same contents, two separate objects are different to Object dot is. So the Effect re-syncs every render.
Fix: create the object inside the Effect. Now the only dependency is room id, a string, which only changes when it really changes.
